# Knowledge Graph

A knowledge graph organizes information as entities (nodes) connected by typed
relationships (edges), enabling structured querying and reasoning over
interconnected facts.

## Key Properties

- Entities are first-class objects with unique identifiers.
- Relationships carry semantic types (e.g., "works_at", "located_in").
- Both entities and relationships can have attributes (properties).
